name: Runemaster Runic Obliteration grants its transform buff on Elemental Burst casts (#2734, partial fix)
contract: Runic Obliteration 705560 Effect0 is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, ProcChance 20, trigger 805742
(a bare SPELL_AURA_DUMMY buff). Spell.dbc ProcFlags is 0 and, before the fix, no spell_proc row
existed, so casting Elemental Burst never granted 805742. After the fix (spell_proc row scoped to
Elemental Burst 802202/family 38 mask2 0x20000, cast phase), repeated Elemental Burst casts must
eventually apply aura 805742. This scenario proves ONLY the proc registration; it does not assert
that a subsequent Primordial Blast cast is redirected into Runic Obliteration (805794); that is
80 accepted, completed native damage casts at the original 20% chance bound zero procs to 0.8^80 (about
Each trial funds normal mana cost and waits for real damage and native cast/global cooldown readiness.
A fixed 2500 ms delay alone does not prove that a cast completed; rejected requests are not proc trials.
Snapshots require a naturally applied ten-second transform aura; this scenario never injects that aura.
